metadata.summary: A large-scale multiple-choice QA dataset for medical education and entrance examination, containing 194,000 questions spanning 21 medical subjects drawn from Indian medical qualifying examinations (AIIMS/NEET-PG). Each question has four answer options and a single correct answer, covering pre-clinical, para-clinical, and clinical medicine.
metadata.purpose: Benchmarking medical knowledge of language models.

papers.title: MedMCQA: A Large-scale Multi-Subject Multi-Choice Dataset for Medical QA

modality.scope: 21 medical subjects covering pre-clinical, para-clinical, and clinical medicine

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: geography.countries is heuristically inferred from limitation text; requires manual verification
The following LLM fields were auto-dropped for violating schema constraints and reverted to baseline; pending manual review: medical_fields[list-items]

known_limitations: Derived from entrance exams (not clinical practice)
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Not representative of global medical curricula or clinical decision-making contexts.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Limited to Indian medical student cohort; no demographic subgroup reporting (e.g., age, gender, institution).

data_origin.selection_rationale: Questions drawn from Indian medical qualifying examinations (AIIMS/NEET-PG) for medical education and entrance examination purposes.

population.target_population: Indian medical students preparing for postgraduate entrance examinations (AIIMS/NEET-PG)
population.missing_groups: Non-Indian medical trainees; practitioners in clinical practice; non-English-speaking or non-Indian curriculum contexts.

annotation.labeling_provenance: Correct answers sourced from official AIIMS/NEET-PG exam answer keys.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Clinical decision support, real-time diagnosis, open-ended explanation generation (due to lack of reasoning-chain labels).
